summary: Frontend-only landing-page conversion pass verified on the live public URL. All required hero/how-it-works/audience/honesty/reward/responsive/dark-mode assertions pass. critical_code_review_comments: Merchant audience door renders the indigo fill on an inner element, so getComputedStyle on the outer [data-testid=audience-door-merchant] reports transparent bg. Visually correct (filled indigo, white text, START HERE ribbon), but if any automated visual test asserts on the outer node's backgroundColor it will fail — consider moving the filled background to the testid element itself.
